entry.title: MBSL - Intervalle
entry.summary: Proyecto por Tommy Hachez con 15 imágenes.
entry.content:
Autor(es): Tommy Hachez, Guillaume Beaulieu, Zorani Sanabria, Mambo Mambo




Intervalle, parcours d'art public

Intervalle est un parcours d'art public qui relie une quarantaine d'œuvres dans les rues de Rivière-du-Loup. Le Musée du Bas-Saint-Laurent l'a imaginé comme une invitation à marcher ou à rouler d'une œuvre à l'autre, à ralentir et à regarder la ville autrement.
Le nom parle de ce qui se passe entre deux points. ​​​​​​​On en fait l'inspiration pour l'image de marque. Le mot lui-même devient un chemin, une ligne qui se plie et se déploie, composée de barres qui évoquent les étapes et la multitude des œuvres. Chaque barre agit comme un module. Le système s'allonge, se replie ou se fragmente selon le circuit, le support ou le lieu, et il pourra continuer de grandir avec le parcours.

Intervalle is a public art route linking around forty artworks across the streets of Rivière-du-Loup. The Musée du Bas-Saint-Laurent imagined it as an invitation to walk or ride from one work to the next, to slow down and see the city differently.  The name speaks to what happens between two points. We made it the inspiration for the brand image. The word itself becomes a path, a line that bends and unfolds, made of bars that evoke the stages and the multitude of artworks. Each bar acts as a module. The system stretches, folds or fragments depending on the route, the medium or the location, and it can keep growing along with the route.

entry.title: OASE : A new skincare system for Mars
entry.summary:
On Mars, skin spends most of the day sealed inside a suit. Weeks of friction and repeated irritation leave a barrier that has no time to recover.
OASE is a speculative skincare brand for the first settlers on Mars. Instead of prescribing products for a fixed skin type, it tracks how skin responds as people move between the airlock, living quarters and sleep pods, and adjusts care as those responses change.
The name comes from oasis. Mars once held water, and traces of it still remain in its rock. OASE takes that idea as its premise: a small source of care in an environment that offers none.
Care runs on the O.A.S.I.S. protocol, a five-step cycle (Observe, Assess, Separate, Invigorate, Sync) that begins again once it ends. It is delivered through a single kit that combines a smart mirror, a skincare device and four cosmetic products. entry.title: ZILART Museum
entry.summary:
ZILART is a new museum of contemporary art in Moscow. Its building is a copper-clad cube with carefully balanced proportions, measuring 60 × 60 meters at its base and rising 36 meters high.
The museum’s visual voice is a custom typeface, ZILART, defined by asymmetric proportions and an expressive rhythm. Designed with the museum’s architectural scale in mind, it works across Cyrillic and Latin scripts, from the logo to typography on copper and concrete surfaces, posters, and digital screens.
The identity becomes part of the museum’s architecture through large-scale typography, gallery numbers conceived as sculptural objects, wayfinding, entrance design, and digital displays. Mint and deep green create a counterpoint to the warm copper facade, while graphite and natural tones complement the building’s materiality. For the museum shop, Collection, we developed a range of publications and objects, including collaborations with contemporary artists.

ZILART is a new museum of contemporary art in Moscow. Its building is a copper-clad cube with carefully balanced proportions, measuring 60 × 60 meters at its base and rising 36 meters high. 

The museum’s collection brings together Russian avant-garde, unofficial Soviet art, international contemporary art, traditional African art, and photography. 
The identity is rooted in the idea of collecting as a creative act: selecting, juxtaposing, and establishing connections. This concept took shape in a flexible system of graphic modules inspired by archival tags and systems of classification, bringing diverse content together into a cohesive whole.

entry.title: Time to head home
entry.summary: Proyecto por Lena Sanver con 7 imágenes.
entry.content:
Autor(es): Lena Sanver


Time to head home
Lena Sanver


SILENCE hangs heavy over the village. The pale pink morning sky is smothered by a thick fog that renders everything gray. A man is coming towards me. As our eyes meet, he looks away—omitting the customary nod that, here in the Swedish countryside, signifies "I see you; I mean no harm." I turn to look after him, but he is nowhere to be seen. Yet, the sound of his footsteps lingers in the silence. Well, Halloween is just around the corner. In truth, he likely turned off onto a smaller path leading toward the forest—the domain of the wolves.

Swedish authorities have decided that 72 wolves are to be culled during next year’s licensed wolf hunt. There are around 20,000 wolves in the EU; of these, approximately 350 live in Sweden. The population count was conducted by hunters who are keen to see them hunted; thus, the actual number of wolves remains an open question. Fortunately, no wolves from "my" pack are slated to be shot next year—they are considered genetically significant and are therefore protected. Other wolf families, however, are to be wiped out—this, despite the fact that the wolf is classified as an endangered species in Sweden. But the hunting lobby is powerful, and there is a great deal of money to be made in hunting. Consequently, neither I nor the wolves have any real say in the matter. In the distance, I hear a horse neigh and the croak of a crow. The silence is beginning to fade, as is the fog. Time to head home for a warm cup of tea.

entry.title: Centennial Warrior | Logo Symbol, Branding & Packaging
entry.summary: Proyecto por zwqy .lab con 22 imágenes.
entry.content:
Autor(es): zwqy .lab, zwqy. LIDIN


百年回力™️品牌视觉符号设计 - vis设计
Brand visual symbol design - vis design
Centennial Warrior: Brand Symbol & Merchandise Design
One shoelace threads a hundred years. This 100th-anniversary upgrade rests on four pillars: symbolic aesthetics, brand DNA, Guochao, and internationalism.
Symbol: The forward momentum of Warrior's F mark is recombined with "100" into a super symbol—shoelace (industry heritage), Chinese dragon (spiritual totem), and F mark (core asset) fused into one, with dragon head and horns signaling industry leadership. A 1927 seal adds cultural confidence. The original red is desaturated into a deep-red retro-modern palette for sustainable extension.
Extension: The dragon-head mark becomes a metal badge on shoelace aglets, DIY-compatible with different uppers. The shoebox uses punched "回力" laced to mimic hand-stitching, with reusable laces enhancing unboxing. The symbol extends into a Warrior Dragon illustration, forming a centennial system across cards, hangtags, tumblers, packaging, badges, plaques, and apparel—unlocking ongoing DIY play.


百年回力，品牌符号及周边延展设计
一根鞋带，串起百年历程。此次100周年品牌升级，整体概要为：符号美学 + 品牌基因 + 国潮元素 + 国际主义。符号设计学： 从回力F标提取向前势能，将品牌基因与“100”重组为超级符号。鞋带—行业母体文化、中国龙—精神图腾、回力F标—品牌核心资产，融入龙头龙角，寓意行业龙头。三者同构于百周年符号。搭配1927年品牌印章，传递文化自信。色彩降调处理，降低原红饱和度，以深红为主基调延展复古调配色系统，兼顾现代美学与可持续延展。
符号的延展运用： 龙头标识打造为金属标，配置于鞋带金属扣，可DIY搭配不同鞋面，增加趣味与传播。鞋盒融入鞋带元素，“回力”中文以打孔穿插鞋带模拟手工针线场景，鞋带可重复使用，提升开盒体验。符号延展为插画回力龙，形成百年符号系统，应用于卡片、吊牌、保温杯、包装、徽章、纪念牌、服装等多元载体，持续解锁DIY玩法。

Autor(es): FORNER STUDIO

Branding for Naugard, a new contemporary art gallery in London championing the next generation of artists.

Throughout the identity, we explored the tension between old and new, building a modern brand mythology through imagined artifacts.

A circular seal centers on Clavis Aurea, Latin for “golden key,” a nod to unlocking hidden or mysterious meaning. A pair of otherworldly guardians extends the story, showing how art transforms the recognizable and invites us to see the familiar anew.
